current.text: Picks 7 to 8 are a fair range for him in 9-cat, with Tatum and Giannis clearly ahead. ESPN's rank of 5 is too high.
Minnesota's two-game week in the middle of the fantasy playoffs drops him to the bottom of his tier, behind Tatum, Giannis and Cade Cunningham. Experts say to move him down in close calls.
With the season ending March 28, Minnesota plays 4, 2 and 4 games in fantasy playoff weeks 19 to 21. The two-game week starts March 15.
Minnesota has 13 back-to-backs this season, the league minimum.
Josh values him at 40 USD or more in auctions.
He sold for 45 USD in an expert mock auction.
Minnesota traded for LaMelo Ball. Julius Randle and Naz Reid are gone, and the team now plays smaller, guard-heavy lineups.
Coach Chris Finch said the team did Edwards a disservice by playing him on the ball so much.
Next to Ball he should play more off the ball, with more catch-and-shoot threes and fewer assists.
His usage may still go up, and with the smaller lineups his rebounds could rise to about 5 per game.
He should be more efficient with Ball taking some of the offensive load. He is projected for about 31% usage and 35 minutes.
If his free throws recover to 84 to 85%, he is about 11th overall.
Minnesota is expected to compete, with a 53-win prediction, so resting players to tank is unlikely.

durable.text: Points and threes are his standout categories, both far above the top 250 pool. He shoots threes at high volume at around 40% and is a strong catch-and-shoot shooter.
Turnovers are his weak category at about 3 per game, and they have stayed fairly flat over the years.
His assist rate has fallen in each of the last three seasons.
He has never finished as a top 10 fantasy player in any format, even though he is drafted there.
He is normally a good free throw shooter. Last season's mark was below his usual level.
He had an iron man reputation, but he missed enough games last season to fall short of All-NBA eligibility.

note: He costs about 59 USD on both sites and went for 55 USD in our league last season. Experts put him at picks 7 to 8 and about 40 to 45 USD at auction, and the two-game playoff semifinal week pushes him lower, so do not pay ESPN's 60 USD value. He fits a punt TO build best, adding elite points and threes. Early in the season, check whether his FT% gets back to 84 to 85% and how his usage and assists hold up next to LaMelo Ball.
